what: The deploy gate's exit law, read by all three preflight clients (JavaScript, Python, Go) so the law is typed once. Each case is a list of per-door outcomes, an optional fail_on set (null means the client's default, {not_ready}), and the exit code the gate must return. Exit codes are integers on purpose: each port keeps its own named constants, and the fixture is the boundary they agree at.

cases.name: unreachable passes by default: a fact about the network path, not the door
unreachable alone still passes by default
refused is usage: a door nobody looked at must not pass a gate
store down outranks a negative verdict

worst.name: store_unreachable folds into unreachable and not_ready outranks it
